hero.title: Get in Touch
hero.subtitle: Have questions? We're here to help. Reach out to us through any of the methods below.

whatsapp.title: Call us on WhatsApp
whatsapp.description: Tap to open a chat with our team.

sendMessage.title: Send us a message
sendMessage.description: Use the form below — it goes straight to our admin team.

form.title: Send us a Message

message.label: Message
message.placeholder: Tell us more about your inquiry...

form.successDescription: Our admin team has received your message and will get back to you soon.

hours.question: What are your support hours?
hours.answer: Our team responds to messages 7 days a week. WhatsApp replies are typically within a few hours.

response.question: How quickly will I get a response?
response.answer: We typically respond to all inquiries within 24 hours.

emergency.question: Do you offer emergency support?
emergency.answer: For urgent matters, please contact us via WhatsApp for the fastest response.

demo.question: Can I schedule a demo?
demo.answer: Yes — visit the Support page and request a video call with our team.
